description: Melee-weapon-gated Shadow bruiser - builds Insanity off Voidforged Edge and Netherstrike, dumps into Obliteration for a big Weapon+Shadow smash. Stay above 40 Insanity for Shadow of the Void's stacking damage buff.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available (Netherstrike, Hammer of Twilight, Entropic Slam confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Voidforged Edge (autoattack proc) + Netherstrike generate Insanity, Obliteration dumps it, crits refund 20 via Twilight's Call, and staying above 40 Insanity triggers Shadow of the Void (stacking Shadow damage/crit buff) - this spec's core identity.

nodes.name: Void Strength
nodes.description: Increases Shadow spell damage and spell hit scaling from Strength by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 40 Passive - Shadow spell damage + spell hit from Strength.'

nodes.name: Voidguard
nodes.description: Grants parry rating from Intellect and hit rating from Strength, at 2% per rank.

nodes.name: N'Zoth's Rage
nodes.description: Passively generates Insanity every second while in combat.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Passively generates 10 Insanity/sec in combat.' Reduced here to 2/sec to avoid trivializing the class-wide Blade of the Empire generator's role.

nodes.name: Maker of Miseries
nodes.description: Reduces all spell and ability Mana costs by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Voidforged Edge
nodes.description: Learn Voidforged Edge: your autoattacks now deal bonus Shadow damage and generate Insanity.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's main generator: 'Autos deal bonus Shadow damage.'

nodes.name: Adaptive Combatant
nodes.description: Increases Parry chance and Dodge chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Bulwark of Horror
nodes.description: Avoiding an attack has a chance to refresh a Blade of the Empire charge.

nodes.name: Hysterical Momentum
nodes.description: Spending Insanity increases attack and movement speed for a duration, stacking.

nodes.name: Netherstrike
nodes.description: Learn Netherstrike, a weapon strike that purges a beneficial magic effect. Usable only against targets below 35% health.
nodes._source: This talent-tree copy of Netherstrike exists so Godblade's tier gating works correctly; the class-wide version (cultist_netherstrike, confirmed Lvl 20 via screenshot) is the same real ability.

nodes.name: Rift
nodes.description: Learn Rift, buffing your next Hammer of Twilight's damage and creating a rift that absorbs the next healing an enemy near you would receive.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Buffs next Hammer of Twilight's damage; creates a rift absorbing next enemy healing near you.' Sets up a guaranteed Obliteration/Hammer crit per the rotation writeup.

nodes.name: Shadow of the Void
nodes.description: While above 40 Insanity, your melee attacks and abilities trigger Shadow of the Void, a stacking Shadow damage and critical strike buff.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Godblade's core identity mechanic: 'Level 20 Passive. Above 40 Insanity, melee attacks/abilities trigger Shadow of the Void.' Once in the pocket, damage snowballs - the whole spec is built around holding this threshold.

nodes.name: Touch of the Void
nodes.description: Increases Magic damage dealt. Hammer of Twilight increases the target's spell damage taken.

nodes.name: Empire's Grasp
nodes.description: Learn Empire's Grasp, teleporting an enemy to you and slowing them.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Teleports an enemy to you + slows.' Real gap-closer/pull tool, called out repeatedly as answering the spec's biggest weakness (kiting).

nodes.name: Voidborne
nodes.description: Increases damage dealt and critical strike chance, grants stun immunity, and generates Insanity each second.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Boosts damage dealt + crit chance, stun immunity; generates 1 Insanity/sec.' Godblade's real burst-and-survival cooldown - 'damage, crit, and stun immunity in one button.'

nodes.name: Nutcase
nodes.description: Shadow of the Void also increases your critical strike damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as the capstone extension of the spec's core identity mechanic: 'Shadow of the Void also boosts crit damage dealt.'

nodes.name: Dreadfall
nodes.description: Learn Dreadfall, a charge strike dealing Shadow damage to enemies passed through and generating extra threat.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Charge strike: Shadow damage to enemies passed through, generates extra threat.'

nodes.name: Entropic Strike
nodes.description: Learn Entropic Strike, a weapon strike that applies Seething Void and generates Void Runes.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Weapon damage + applies Seething Void + generates 2 Void Runes.'

nodes.name: Seething Void
nodes.description: Entropic Strike's curse now deals repeating Eldritch damage. Melee crits refresh it and spread it to a nearby enemy.

nodes.name: Twilight's Call
nodes.description: Critical strikes with Obliteration refund Insanity.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a core rotation piece: 'Crits refund 20 via Twilight's Call.'

nodes.name: Who Needs Sanity?
nodes.description: Netherstrike critical strikes stack a bonus to your critical strike damage.

nodes.name: Voidseeker
nodes.description: Netherstrike resets, becoming usable regardless of the target's health.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Netherstrike also purges a magic buff and, via Voidseeker, resets to become an any-health execute.'

nodes.name: Tentacle of N'Zoth
nodes.description: Learn Tentacle of N'Zoth, a ground summon that silences and repeatedly damages the target, re-targeting if they flee.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground summon: silences + repeats damage on target; re-targets if target flees range.' Real caster-lockdown tool.

nodes.name: Eldritch Obelisk
nodes.description: Learn Eldritch Obelisk, a ground summon that boosts nearby Tentacle damage and ally movement speed.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground summon: boosts nearby Tentacle damage + ally movement speed.' Sustained-fight support tool.

nodes.name: Broken Mind
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of fear and charm effects used against you by 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Summon: Faceless Destroyer
nodes.description: Learn Summon: Faceless Destroyer, summoning an ally that fights alongside you for a duration.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Summons an ally-fighting destroyer for a duration.' Real pet-summon burst tool.

nodes.name: Cosmic Horror
nodes.description: Umbral Voyage horrifies enemies at its landing spot, and increases your damage to them for the duration.

nodes.name: Encroaching Presence
nodes.description: Melee critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Rift and Gaze of C'Thun.

nodes.name: Abyssal Command
nodes.description: Nearby Crusher Tentacles deal AoE Shadow damage, scaling with Intellect, and knock enemies airborne.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'AoE Shadow damage from nearby Crusher Tentacles (scales with Intellect); knocks enemies airborne.'
